Privacy.metaDesc: Privacy policy and disclaimer for using the unofficial USV Portal platform.
Privacy.title:
Privacy Policy
& Disclaimer
Privacy.subtitle: Information about how this project works and how your data is handled.
Privacy.sec1Text1: This application is an independent project (Proof of Concept) and is not affiliated, associated, authorized, or in any official way connected with the 'Stefan cel Mare' University of Suceava.
Privacy.sec1Text2: The purpose is to provide a modern interface for the PeopleSoft student portal, bypassing the technical limitations of the original platform that block access from modern browsers.
Privacy.step1: You enter your login credentials in your local browser.
Privacy.step2: The proxy server transmits them directly to scolaritate.usv.ro through the internal university VPN.
Privacy.step3: USV responds with your data, the server formats it and returns it to your browser.
Privacy.statelessNote: The server is stateless — there is no database, no passwords or personal data are stored on disk. Data exists exclusively in memory for the duration of the session.
Privacy.sec3Text: The platform is accessible at https://noteusv.tech. The connection between browser and server is fully encrypted through the Cloudflare network (SSL/TLS).
Privacy.rec1: Do not enable 'Remember username' on public or shared computers.
Privacy.rec2: Always use the HTTPS connection — do not access the portal on unsecured Wi-Fi networks.
Privacy.rec3: The code is open-source — you can clone the repository and run the server locally for full control.
Privacy.sec4Text: The service is provided 'as is', without any explicit or implicit warranty. The author assumes no liability for:
Privacy.disclaimer1: Errors, unavailability, or malfunctions of the USV platform.
Privacy.disclaimer2: Security incidents caused by use on unsecured networks.
Privacy.disclaimer3: Account lockouts resulting from incorrect use of the authentication API.
Privacy.sec5Text: To ensure the proper functioning of your session, this platform uses two essential technical cookies:
Privacy.cookieDetail:
PS_PROXY_SESSION: This functional session cookie contains the encrypted token necessary to ensure secure communication between your browser and the proxy during grades queries (it is automatically deleted upon logging out or closing the browser).

NEXT_LOCALE: This functional persistent cookie remembers your chosen language (Romanian or English) to automatically display the translated interface on your future visits (lasts for 1 year).
Privacy.cookieMarketing: We do not use any marketing, advertising, profiling, or traffic analysis cookies (no Google Analytics, trackers, or third-party tracking scripts).
Privacy.sec6Text1: This project is openly distributed as free software under the MIT License. The entire source code, interface design, and platform architecture are designed and fully developed by Vichiriuc Adrian (@28VYK).
Privacy.sec6Text2: Since the code is completely public, anyone has the opportunity to inspect its transparency and security, and run their own local instance for full control. Complete legal conditions and attribution details can be found in the license files in the project repository.

FAQ.pageTitle: Frequently Asked Questions - USV Grades without VPN | USV Student Portal
FAQ.metaDesc: Complete answers to questions about USV grades, academic status, access without VPN, security, and timetable. Unofficial USV Portal - noteusv.tech
FAQ.title:
Frequently Asked
Questions (FAQ)
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about using the unofficial USV Portal.
FAQ.q1: How do I access USV grades and academic status without a VPN?
FAQ.a1: Our portal acts as a **secure intermediate proxy**. When you log in on noteusv.tech, our server automatically establishes the necessary connection and queries the official USV system (scolaritate.usv.ro) on your behalf. Consequently, you can view your grades, exams, and academic status instantly from any device (phone, tablet, or laptop) without installing FortiClient or other VPN applications. It is the ideal solution for USV students who want quick access to USV grades without complications.
FAQ.q2: Is it safe to enter my login credentials on this portal?
FAQ.a2: Yes, the security and privacy of your data are our top priorities. The portal operates in a completely **stateless** manner — we do not store any passwords or personal information. Your authentication credentials are transmitted fully encrypted via HTTPS (secured by Cloudflare) directly to the university's servers and are deleted immediately after use. The entire project's source code is open-source on GitHub, so it can be audited by anyone at any time. USV Student Portal was created specifically to provide secure access to USV grades.
FAQ.q3: Why doesn't scolaritate.usv.ro work directly anymore and how do we solve this?
FAQ.a3: The official USV student platform (scolaritate.usv.ro) uses legacy technologies (PeopleSoft) and an SSL certificate that is no longer compatible with modern web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari). These browsers block direct access for security reasons. Our portal acts as a modern translator: securely retrieving data in the background and displaying it in a fast, clean interface that is fully compatible with current web standards. This way, you can access your USV academic status without issues.
FAQ.q4: What do I do if I can't log in or get an authentication error on USV grades?
FAQ.a4: First, verify that your username is in the correct format (typically FIRSTNAME.LASTNAME or firstname.lastname@student.usv.ro). If the credentials are correct but you still get an error, the official server of the Stefan cel Mare University of Suceava is likely temporarily unavailable (due to maintenance, overload, or technical issues). Please wait 5-10 minutes and try again. If the issue persists, you can check the status on your faculty's Facebook groups or contact the student registry.
FAQ.q5: How can I calculate my GPA and simulate grades before the exam session?
FAQ.a5: Once logged in to the USV student portal, go to the **GPA Analysis** section. There you will find a complete grade simulator. You can enter estimated grades for courses, seminars, or labs for subjects that do not have final grades entered yet. The system automatically calculates your annual arithmetic average, ECTS weighted GPA, and total credits and points. It is an extremely useful tool to plan your exam session and see exactly what grades you need for a scholarship or promotion.
FAQ.q6: Where can I find my faculty's timetable?
FAQ.a6: The complete and updated schedule for all faculties, specializations, and groups at Stefan cel Mare University of Suceava can be found on the dedicated platform **orar.usv.ro**. On our website, you have a direct link in the header and on the /orar page. There you can easily filter by faculty, group, series, or professor. The timetable platform is developed by USV students and is the best official source for updated information.
